latin: Vtrum quantitas sit per se uel participatiue uisibilis.
translation: Whether quantity is visible in its own right, or only by participation.
translator: original translation, drafted 2026-09-26 by WRITER-light-batch10, from Latin at farmer1998:24384
translation_note: 'per se uel participatiue' (farmer1998:24384): in itself, or only by participation in something else.
